_supersedes: The old 'project webhook' + workerDispatchTable entry that used to be here. That design assumed logicblock invocation from an event wasn't possible in the console and worked around it with a single catch-all external.webhook firing on every Project update, with a worker-side dispatch table reading payload.status. CONFIRMED WRONG as of this pipeline: event_type 'custom_api' (block invocation) is real and works live — created via mcp__nostackai__create_event with destination_config.target_entity = the logicblock's apiname and field_mapping translating the triggering record into the block's declared inputSchema (per get_platform_capabilities' fieldMappingGuide: '_query.<field>' for a query-sourced input, value 'source.<field>' copied from the triggering record). This resolves ISSUES.md issue #9's remaining open question — block invocation from an event is real, not just theoretical, and the 5 events below are proof, created cleanly with zero errors on the live org.

name: ingest_source_on_create
rationale: Fires on every new ContentSource row regardless of source_type — ingest's own condition step branches on source_type internally, so no entry_conditions needed here.
_correction: Two bugs found live 2026-08-18, both silently broke every invocation since this event was created — every ContentSource sat stuck at status='draft' forever, never even reaching 'processing'. (1) target_entity was 'ingest_source', which was never the block's actual apiname — when pasted into the console it saved as 'ingest' (confirmed via list_logicblocks; a second block 'ingestpdf' also exists now, a manual duplicate for testing an unconfigured PDF ai_call step — the event was pointed at 'ingest', the fully-working original, not the duplicate). (2) field_mapping used '_query.content_source_id' but the block's declared input field (per its inputSchema and its own s1 step reading {{input._query.contentsource_id}}) is 'contentsource_id', no underscore between 'content' and 'source'. Fixing the event does NOT retroactively reprocess ContentSource rows created before the fix — they need to be recreated or the ingest block re-invoked manually for their ids via the console's API test tool.
_recreated: This event was entirely deleted on 2026-09-02 — the user clicked what they believed was a 'Disable' button in the console and it deleted the event outright instead (see ISSUES.md's newest issue). Recreated identically via create_event, new id above. Same non-retroactive caveat applies again for anything created in the gap.

name: trigger_start_render
note: This is the ONE stage transition the app's UI actually needs a button for in the new pipeline — every other stage transition happens automatically as a side effect of the previous logicblock's own update_entity step advancing project.status. The render worker call itself happens INSIDE start_render (a webhook step), not via a separate event.

name: project notification.email
rationale: UPDATED — condition value changed from 'published' to 'ready' to match the new status enum. Still doesn't solve the actual owner-email problem, since Project has no email field to source {{source.*}} from — 'to' is still the literal placeholder string 'YOUR-ALERT-EMAIL', not a real address. Needs a real destination (e.g. a stored owner_email field, or resolve via context at a different layer) before this is more than a placeholder.
_correction: The destination_config field is 'to', not 'to_email' as this file previously documented — confirmed live: create_event rejected 'to_email' with 'missing required field(s): to'. All 5 events under project (this one + the 4 trigger_* events) were deleted-in-effect and recreated fresh this session (list_events on 'project' came back empty before recreation, meaning they weren't actually live despite the earlier '_supersedes' note claiming so) — ids above are the new live ones.
